Usage:
  dotnet t3mmyvsa make:entity <EntityName> [--base] [--force]
  dotnet t3mmyvsa make:feature <EntityName> [--force]

Defaults:
  make:entity creates an AuditableEntity.
  Use --base only when audit timestamps are intentionally unnecessary.
  Existing generated files are never overwritten unless --force is supplied.
